messages:
pagerduty-bot: SEV-2 — elevated latency & increased 5xxs observed for tenant Krypton (vpc-krypton-prod). Alerts: p95 token latency 2.3s -> 6.8s, 504 spike ~1.2%. paging oncall.
Maria G.: on it. passing to oncall.
Ash S. (SRE): I see the spike, errors concentrated on model rw-large-v2 under the dedicated pool. KV cache miss rate up ~40%.
Jonah R.: any deploys? changes to routing?
Lee T. (runtime): no infra deploys in last hour. We got a kernel fallback on some nodes (nvlink pressure). Runtime started falling back to non-quantized path causing latency.
Ash S. (SRE): ok. customer is on dedicated pool + VPC, we should avoid full rollback of infra. proposal: pin tenant to a safe, quantized variant and route a 5% canary to that variant while we stabilize nodes.
Maria G.: @Anya C. can you notify Krypton SREs that we're running a canary pin? they asked for heads-up before any model changes.
Anya C. (CSM): pinged kry-sre@krypton.com (threaded). said "please canary first, keep logs".
Lee T. (runtime): suggested safe model: rw-safe-1.1-quant (lower memory, quantized kernels we've stress-tested). Plan: 1) pin canary 5% 2) monitor p95 and 5xx for 10m 3) if stable, promote to 100% 4) record audit and schedule postmortem.
Jonah R.: I'll run the canary and watch metrics. if p95 drops under 3s and 5xx < 0.5% after 10m, we'll promote.
Ash S. (SRE): are there any customer-specific routing rules? e.g., pinned overrides?
Maria G.: Krypton has tenant-level overrides allowed. we have permission to pin within dedicated.
Lee T. (runtime): executing pin via internal API now. command: ```
# canary pin 5%
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/tenants/krypton/pin"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rw-safe-1.1-quant","rollout_percent":5,"note":"canary: mitigate latency spike 2971234567"}'
```
pagerduty-bot: action taken: canary pin job queued.
Jonah R.: canary live. metrics: p95 initial 6.8s -> 4.2s at +2m, 5xx 504s down to 0.9% (was 1.2%).
Ash S. (SRE): good sign. however KV miss still high. we should enable prefix caching for common greetings for this tenant to reduce KV churn. Lee can we toggle prefix caching?
Lee T. (runtime): yes adding small prefix cache TTL for tenant requests. command: ```
rwdctl tenant update --tenant krypton --prefix-cache-ttl 5s
```
Maria G.: noted for audit. Anya, please relay to customer that we've started canary + cache tweak; we'll update in 15m.
Anya C. (CSM): messaged customer: "We've started a 5% canary to a safe variant and a short caching tweak. Monitoring closely. Will update in 15m."
Jonah R.: at +10m: p95 2.9s, 5xx 0.45%, error budget not being burned further. recommend promote to 100%.
Ash S. (SRE): agree. run promotion. Also mark nodes with nvlink pressure for maintenance so runtime avoids them in future rollouts.
Lee T. (runtime): promoting to 100% now. API: ```
# promote to 100%
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/tenants/krypton/pin/promote"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -d '{"model":"rw-safe-1.1-quant"}'
```
pagerduty-bot: pin promotion job started.
Jonah R.: monitoring: p95 stabilizing ~2.5s, 5xx ~0.3%. good.
Maria G.: notifying oncall handoff in 30m to SRE duty; will schedule postmortem and include: root cause (nvlink pressure -> kernel fallback), mitigation (tenant pin to rw-safe-1.1-quant, prefix cache), and permanent actions (node fencing, routing fallback policy update).
Ash S. (SRE): follow-ups: 1) add a pre-emptive safe-variant mapping for tenants on dedicated pools so we can auto-canary on spikes 2) refine rollouts to allow 10% fast path for latency-sensitive customers 3) create a short-runbook for CSMs to inform customers.
Anya C. (CSM): I will draft the customer-facing note and share in #customer-communications.
Maria G.: final note for handoff: incident resolved for customer impact. SRE oncall: Jonah R. will take notes and hand off to next oncall at +30m. postmortem ticket: INT-2026-345.
Jonah R.: taking handoff notes now. will attach graphs and command logs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: SEV-2 transitioned -> resolved for tenant Krypton. incident closed in 47m.
